ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against OFAC SDN List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Egyptian Central Bank terrorist finance lists, and Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit domestic designations. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons (PEPs), high-risk jurisdictions, and any counterparty in the surplus aviation parts distribution chain. Suspicious transactions, during formation or through escrow, must be reported to the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit under Law No. 80 of 2002.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Electronic Company Registry Portal and Commercial Registry (Al-Sijil Al-Tijari) of the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal trade name must be in Arabic; a Latin/English transliteration may be registered as a secondary trade name only. The Arabic name must have no phonetic or visual resemblance to existing registered names, must avoid geographically restricted terms, and must adhere to the General Authority for Investment's naming rules for limited liability companies. Aviation/Aerospace terms require pre-approval of the Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority before GAFI clearing.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Aviation/Aerospace (without Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority pre-approval)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must file a written administrative appeal with the GAFI Appeals Committee within 30 calendar days from the date of the rejection notice. The appeal must include the original rejection notice, corrected/reconstructed name options, and any required prior approval from sector-specific authorities (e.g., Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority). GAFI must issue a decision within 30 working days; further review can be pursued before the Administrative Court within 60 days after exhaustion of internal remedies.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not acceptable as the sole registered address for an LLC engaging in licensed commercial aviation parts distribution. A physical commercial office in Egypt is required for GAFI registration, tax office registration, and the sectoral license under the Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority. A virtual office may only be used as a supplementary correspondence address after the physical registered office is established and evidenced by a notarized lease contract.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection: approximately 75% within the first 18 months of operation, because GAFI, the Egyptian Tax Authority, and Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority routinely verify commercial substance for licensed trading entities and aviation surplus dealers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egypt Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended by Law No. 94 of 2005 and Law No. 17 of 2014 (One-Stop Shop), particularly Articles 1, 4-6, 24-30; assisted by Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 for foreign-invested LLCs and the Egyptian Commercial Registration Law No. 34 of 1976.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Company Registration Administration and Commercial Registry, Cairo, Arab Republic of Egypt
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Ettifaq Ta'sis) and the statutory Application for Incorporation of a Limited Liability Company (executive regulations Form).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital is prescribed for an LLC; however the issued share capital stated in the Articles must be fully subscribed and paid-up before filing. Cash capital must be deposited into an Egyptian bank account in the prospective LLC's name; in-kind contributions require an independent valuation. No general escrow obligation applies, but a guarantee escrow may be required under an investment approval or the aviation spares licence condition.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the share subscription statement is approved, and each shareholder subscribes to the company's share capital as shown in the subscription schedule; RESOLVED, that the Articles of Association vetted by counsel are adopted and the registered office is established in Cairo, Arab Republic of Egypt, to receive all statutory notifications; RESOLVED, that the undersigned shareholders appoint [General Manager Name] as General Manager/CEO and [Chairman Name] as Chairman for a two-year term; RESOLVED, that the General Manager is authorized to open escrow accounts, execute all applications with GAFI and the Commercial Registry, procure the tax card and sectoral permits, and retain Egyptian legal counsel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and GAFI Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop and Electronic Investment Portal (invest.investment.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the GAFI investor portal and submit three proposed Arabic trade names together with one Romanised equivalent. The system automatically screens against the Commercial Registry index and protected names. GAFI issues a name reservation certificate valid for 30 days. For aviation spares distribution, attach a brief activity description enabling GAFI to coordinate a preliminary no-objection with the civil aviation licensing directorate if requested.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of each shareholder
Power of attorney if signed by a representative
Name reservation application form
Memorandum of appointment of the filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or rejected, amend the proposed names, provide alternative Arabic transliterations, or remove a name that conflicts with a registered mark; resubmit within 10 working days through the same portal, quoting the query reference number.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice Notary Public Office and GAFI Legal Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the bilingual draft of the Directive of the LLC to the chosen notary public. All founding shareholders must appear in person or through duly authorised attorneys, sign every page, and authenticate their signatures. The notary certifies the founding contract as per Companies Law No. 159/1981. Thereafter, submit the notarised copy to GAFI's legal department for a conformity stamp if a custom rather than standard-form articles is used.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (Arabic and English)
Passports or national IDs of all shareholders
Power of attorney forms (if applicable)
Approved name reservation certificate
First Board Resolution appointing officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or GAFI rejects a clause, replace the contested provision with the standard GAFI model wording, remove unenforceable restrictions, and re-notarize the corrected version against the same fee receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit and Temporary Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian Bank – Corporate Desk (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr, Commercial International Bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the name reservation certificate and preliminary Articles, instruct the bank to open a temporary cash account under the founder's names in the prospective LLC name. Deposit the entire subscribed paid-up capital in EGP or convertible foreign currency. The bank issues the capital deposit receipt and, if requested, a no-objection letter for GAFI. For in-kind capital, obtain a certified valuation report and deposit a sworn statement by the contributor.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Preliminary Memorandum and Articles of Association
Shareholders' passports or national IDs
Resolution of the Board appointing officers and authorising bank account opening
Source of funds declaration and AML/KYC questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises AML or KYC queries, submit enhanced due diligence documents including a bank reference letter, ultimate beneficial owner declaration, and a copy of the notarised Articles; escalate to the bank's compliance officer for expedited review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing, Commercial Registration, and Tax Card Issue
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop – Company Registration and Commercial Registry Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete notarised incorporation package with GAFI through the consolidated One-Stop Shop counter. GAFI reviews the Articles, capital receipt, lease of the registered office, and the bank certificate; once approved, GAFI enters the LLC into the Electronic Commercial Registry and issues the company registration certificate and the commercial registry extract. The same session automatically initiates the provisional tax card of the new entity.
required_dossiers: Notarised Memorandum and Articles of Association
Bank capital deposit receipt
Commercial lease contract of the registered office (validated by the local council where required)
First Board Resolution
Name reservation certificate
Completion of GAFI incorporation application form
Power of attorney of the filing representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Should GAFI issue a clarification notice, respond in Arabic through the same One-Stop Shop window within 15 days. Minor discrepancies in the capital schedule or lease address are cured by an explanatory memorandum, while material changes require a supplementary notarised resolution and a fresh filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Tax and Social Insurance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and National Social Insurance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After GAFI issues the commercial register extract, the LLC must complete the ETA tax card application by submitting the registration extract and lease contract to the competent tax office, thereby obtaining the permanent tax card with the tax file number. If hiring employees, effectuate social insurance registration within one month. Complete the VAT registration if taxable annual turnover exceeds the registration threshold. For importation of surplus commercial aircraft parts, apply to the General Organization for Export and Import Control for an importer registration.
required_dossiers: Commercial registry extract issued by GAFI
Updated lease contract of the head office
Passports and national IDs of shareholders and proposed manager
Form of tax card application
Social insurance employers' register form
Import/export registration application (if required)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ETA fails to issue the tax card within the SLA, obtain a stamped acknowledgement of the application and escalate to the tax office's director for the Cairo jurisdiction. Correct any deficiencies in the lease or shareholder identification evidence and resubmit with a cover letter citing the SAX reference.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority (ECAA) – Directorates of Licensing, Aircraft Spares and Components Certification (under the Ministry of Civil Aviation), together with GAFI for investment measure coordination
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: License for Trading and Distribution of Aircraft Spare Parts and Components (Aircraft Parts Distributor Decree-Licence) issued under ECAA Civil Aviation Regulations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Environmental Registration (Standard Form B), not requiring a Full EIA, unless the warehouse exceeds 2,000 m² or uses solvent cleaning and painting booths, in which case a Scoped EIA under Category 1/2 is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Discharges to public sewer must comply with Law 93/1962 and its amendments (BOD5 ≤ 60 mg/L, COD ≤ 120 mg/L, TSS ≤ 60 mg/L); indoor and fugitive VOC emissions from lifting/handling processes must meet the ambient limits of Ministerial Decree No. 950/2014; all aerospace fluid residues, chemical wastes and batteries are governed by Hazardous Waste Management Decree No. 520/2018 and must be stored in secondary containment and collected by licensed carriers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the General Administration of Civil Defense for the storage facility must verify automatic detection, extinguishers, egress and flammable liquid storage compliance. A structural load inspection report prepared by a licensed engineering office is required for racking and warehouse floors. The Governorate issues the building occupancy/operation clearance following civil defense approval; the Manpower Office conducts an occupational health inspection covering chemical SDS, ventilation standards, emergency exits, and appointment of a first-aid officer.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – official portal: www.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must appoint a local tax representative in Egypt and apply for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and VAT registration certificate through the Egyptian Tax Authority's registration portal. The application requires the commercial registry extract, power of attorney, incorporation deed, passport copies of managers, proof of office address, and the completed ETA registration forms in Arabic. After submission, the ETA validates the documentation, performs a physical inspection of the registered office, and issues the statutory TIN/VAT ID.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections are available under Egyptian tax law; the LLC is taxed as a standalone legal entity, and no fiscal transparency election is recognized for corporate income tax purposes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover (goods) / EGP 150,000 annual taxable turnover (services)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt operates a mandatory electronic invoicing (e-invoice) and e-receipt system administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority. Businesses exceeding the turnover threshold must issue invoices in XML format through the ETA e-invoice portal, obtain a unique QR code from the authority's digital stamping system, and transmit invoices in real-time for fiscal clearance. The system uses API-based submission, schema validation, and digital signature requirements; failure to comply triggers automatic rejection and fines.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and services are zero-rated under Egyptian VAT if the following conditions are met: the supplier is a registered VAT taxpayer; the goods are physically exported from Egypt within the legally prescribed period; the supplier retains documentary proof of exportation; and the consideration is paid in convertible foreign currency through a bank that has received the export proceeds. Service exports are eligible if the service is supplied to a non-resident for use entirely outside Egypt.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Egyptian Tax Authority conducts strict desk and field audits of export zero-rating claims, cross-matching customs export records, bank receipts, and VAT returns. Fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating claims result in immediate levy of 14% VAT, late payment penalties, administrative fines up to 200% of the tax due, potential imprisonment under Law 67 of 2016 and the Penal Code for tax evasion, and retrospective clawback of refunds with compound interest. Repatriation of export proceeds beyond 180 days without a Central Bank exemption leads to cancellation of zero-rating and automatic VAT reassessment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) - Foreign Exchange Administration. Primary instruments: Exchange Control Law No. 38 of 1994 and Executive Regulations; Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020 (replacing Law No. 88 of 2003); CBE circulars and Board decisions. Only CBE-licensed banks may execute foreign exchange operations and report FX transactions to the CBE.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains current-account convertibility under IMF Article VIII; the CBE unified the EGP exchange rate in March 2024 under the IMF Extended Fund Facility, removing the parallel-market premium. Capital-account transactions remain controlled: foreign direct investment must be registered with GAFI; portfolio inflows require prior CBE approval. Profit remittance (dividends and branch profits) is legally permitted for foreign investors after corporate tax clearance, audited financials, CBE FX declaration, and source-of-funds verification; however, USD liquidity pressure can create settlement queues of 2-8 weeks for non-priority sectors. The Company should hold a USD liquidity buffer and maintain USD credit lines with at least two relationship banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory conversion of export proceeds to EGP is imposed. Per CBE Executive Regulations under Law No. 38 of 1994, exporters must repatriate proceeds through an authorized Egyptian bank within the maturity agreed on the CBE export declaration (market practice: 180 days from the bill of lading or air waybill for L/C sales, extendable to 360 days for open account with bank consent) and credit them to a foreign-currency account. Proceeds can be retained in USD or sold to the bank. Non-repatriation or late repatriation without documented underlying export transactions triggers CBE reporting sanctions, facility suspension, and penalties under Law No. 38 of 1994 and Law No. 194 of 2020.

Operational Account plus Trade Finance Facility (SWIFT MT103/MT700) and digital FX portal

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Form 47) with audited financial statements, tax reconciliation schedules, and transfer-pricing disclosure forms
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Corporate Tax Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of fiscal year-end; April 30 for calendar-year taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late-payment surcharge of 2% on unpaid tax; minimum fixed fine of EGP 10,000 for failure to file; administrative bank attachment and criminal prosecution for persistent non-filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry under the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal window January 1 through March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Overdue renewal triggers escalating administrative fines; non-renewal beyond one year results in suspension of the registration and administrative strike-off of the entity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual tax card renewal (certificate of tax status)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Taxpayer Registration Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal due before March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Cancellation of the tax card, administrative fine of EGP 500-1,000, and suspension of import-clearance and bank-account transactions requiring a valid tax card

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) confirmation declaration and share transfer notification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Companies Registry and the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU) Economic Data Center
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days of each fiscal year-end; any share transfer must be recorded and filed within 30 days of the transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to EGP 100,000 under Companies Law 194/2023; AML-law penalties up to EGP 2,000,000 and suspension of quota-holder voting rights for undisclosed transfers

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting (AGM) quota-holder approval record and audited financial statements filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: AGM within 6 months of fiscal year-end; financial statements circulated 21 days before the meeting and filed within 15 days after approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: EGP 10,000 fine for failure to convene the AGM within the statutory period; GAFI may appoint an external inspector and instigate compulsory dissolution proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of the aviation spares trading commercial license (certified civil aircraft rotables and avionics surplus distribution)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority (ECAA) - Economic and Commercial Licensing Directorate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based renewal filed at least 30 days before expiry; permit valid for one calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic suspension of import and trading privileges; daily administrative penalty for late renewal; revocation of the aviation dealer permit for continued non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All LLCs must engage a licensed Egyptian auditor. A mandatory full statutory audit applies to LLCs exceeding any two of the following thresholds: annual turnover EGP 10,000,000 (approx. USD 320,000), total assets EGP 5,000,000 (approx. USD 160,000), or workforce of 50 employees; dormant or micro entities below EGP 1,000,000 turnover may apply to the ETA for an audit-waiver review engagement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), IFRS-aligned, issued by the Egyptian Ministry of Finance; statutory books and financial statements must be maintained in Arabic, with a convenience English translation permitted for non-resident stakeholders.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain an up-to-date UBO register and file the annual UBO confirmation with GAFI and EMLCU within 60 days of the fiscal year-end irrespective of any ownership change. Each share transfer must be approved, stamped, recorded in the quota-holder register, and notified to GAFI within 30 days, including the annual consolidated confirmation of the full shareholding chain for non-resident owners.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders and Board Resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - USD 2,500 per annum for registered office, corporate secretarial, and statutory agent services in Cairo
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 4,500 per annum for a certified Egyptian audit engagement, depending on turnover, inventory cycles, and ECAA reporting requirements

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% (standard corporate income tax rate for juridical persons under Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005; higher sector-specific rates may apply to banks, petroleum and telecommunications activities).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Egyptian free zones and the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) may grant a 5-year income tax holiday, renewable under the Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; projects in priority sectors or high-priority governorates may claim statutory deductions of up to 50% of capital investment costs; additional reductions apply to labor-intensive projects. No general patent-box regime applies to aircraft parts distributors.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 50 — Corporate Income Tax Return (juridical persons), filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-services portal at www.eta.gov.eg.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; the same return reconciles quarterly provisional corporate tax prepayments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Form No. 50 must be submitted within four months after the close of the fiscal year; final tax due must be paid by the same deadline unless an approved instalment arrangement exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Taxpayer Identity and License Data
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, tax card number, commercial registration number, civil aviation trading license number and registered address of the Egyptian LLC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the Egyptian permanent establishment (PE) or dependent agent; ensure a valid Egyptian tax identification number has been obtained before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 — Fiscal Year and Accounting Basis
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year commencement and end dates; basis of accounting and inventory valuation for surplus aircraft rotables and avionics.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE must use Egyptian fiscal-year alignment consistent with its financial statements; treaty-protected offshore sales must be separately stated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All sales revenue from distribution of certified civil aircraft rotables, avionics surplus, exchange programs and related logistics services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate revenue between Egyptian-source PE activity and offshore title-passing transactions; avoid attributing PE revenue to a non-resident head office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 — Cost of Goods Sold and Inventory
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of surplus aircraft parts sold, customs duties, freight, insurance and warehouse costs; closing inventory of rotables and avionics.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany purchase prices from foreign related suppliers must satisfy arm's-length standards and be supported by transfer pricing records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Rent, payroll, license fees, third-party inspection and certification costs, bank charges and depreciation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Head-office charges and management fees are only deductible when supported by cost allocation agreements and actual services rendered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate value of purchases, commissions, royalties, interest and management fees with foreign related parties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory disclosure of transactions equal to or above the EGP 8 million local-file threshold; incomplete disclosure may trigger criminal tax evasion review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting profit reconciled to taxable profit after adding non-deductible expenses and deducting available 5-year tax losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident PE, taxable profit must be computed under the limitation on profit attribution for dependent-agent PEs and force-of-attraction rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed corporate income tax, provisional tax credits, foreign tax credits and residual amount payable with the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividend WHT is not deferred by retaining profits in the Egyptian LLC; the tax due must be paid from Egyptian bank accounts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or late payment: 2% additional tax per month or part of a month of delay, capped at 100% of the tax due; false or incomplete filings can lead to double assessments, license suspension, revocation of the tax card and criminal referral.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividend distributions made by Egyptian juridical persons to shareholders; treaty-resident shareholders may claim reduced rates under an applicable double-tax agreement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The foreign beneficial owner must submit a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by its home-state competent authority, together with a beneficial-ownership declaration and Form for DTA relief to the Egyptian Tax Authority before distribution or before the relevant withholding return deadline; ETA approval permits application of the reduced treaty rate or refund of excess withheld tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates under Egyptian income tax law: royalties for intellectual property and technical/certification data 20%; debt interest paid to non-residents generally 20%. Egypt's tax treaty network commonly reduces royalties and interest to 10–15%, with 0% limited to specific governmental or supranational financing arrangements.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory when annual aggregate related-party transactions with Egyptian operations equal or exceed EGP 8,000,000; Master File is mandatory when the worldwide consolidated turnover of the ultimate parent equals or exceeds EGP 20,000,000,000. Documentation must be prepared before the Form No. 50 due date and submitted to the ETA within 30–60 days of request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not impose a standalone Caribbean-style Economic Substance Regulations statute, but the Income Tax Law and Investment Law require a genuine Egyptian presence, a licensed aviation trading warehouse or distribution capacity, payroll and board substance, and real inventory risk. A shell LLC used solely to route surplus aircraft parts invoices or to access SCZone tax benefits will be disregarded, with all treaty and zone incentives recaptured.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing a false Form No. 50, using forged invoices, omitting surplus aircraft parts sales, understating inventory revaluation gains or hiding cash sales from aviation off-takers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fines of 100%–300% or more of the evaded tax, imprisonment for up to 5 years, seizure of inventory and bank accounts, revocation of the Egyptian tax card and civil aviation distribution license, and disqualification from public-sector aviation tenders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or direct the false return are personally, jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax, penalties and surcharges; courts will pierce the LLC veil for fraud and impose travel bans and asset freezes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Sham Substance / Treaty Shopping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Egyptian LLC has no real office, no authorized aviation inventory, no qualified employees and no actual aircraft parts handling, while invoices are circulated through offshore associates solely to claim foreign treaty rates or free-zone exemptions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disallowance of the entity's separate tax personality, retroactive denial of DTA and free-zone tax benefits, reallocation of profits to the real economic owner, strike-off from the commercial register and payment of tax plus a 100% non-deduction penalty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced for abuse of legal personality; directors and significant shareholders are personally liable for the resulting corporate tax liability, with criminal imprisonment applicable for forged residency certificates or false beneficial-ownership declarations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation Failure and Artificial Financing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare the Local File when related-party transactions exceed EGP 8,000,000; mispricing surplus aircraft parts in intercompany trade; or charging excessive interest/royalty payments to a related offshore entity without economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA transfer-pricing adjustment, recharacterization of excess payments as deemed dividends, nondeductibility of interest/royalties, monthly 2% late-payment surcharges and penalty additions up to 100% of the adjusted tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly submit incomplete TP disclosures or authorize artificial invoicing are jointly liable for corporate tax deficiencies; criminal referral can result in imprisonment for up to 5 years and confiscation of the profit margin earned from the manipulated transactions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering, Trade-Based AML and Export Control Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Buying or distributing surplus civil aircraft parts without the mandatory aviation trading license, selling to sanctioned or high-risk counterparties, concealing the ultimate beneficial owner, or using cash and non-monitored payment rails outside licensed escrow and SWIFT channels.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to EGP 20 million under Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2016, confiscation of the aircraft parts and proceeds, revocation of the customs and tax licenses, mandatory reporting to the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit, and closure of the aviation parts warehouse.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, beneficial owners and compliance officers qualify as controlling persons and may face imprisonment, joint civil restitution, asset freezes, travel bans for up to 10 years and forfeiture of all unlawful profits derived from tainted surplus-parts transactions.
